name: Standing Order Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of standing order, such as a user defined standing order or a predefined liquidity transfer.

USTO.name: User Defined Standing Order
USTO.definition: Liquidity transfer standing order type, that has been customised or defined to the specific need of the user.

PSTO.name: Predefined Standing Order
PSTO.definition: Liquidity transfer standing order type, as predefined in the system.
